# KDIAL

> KDIAL is Kerala's local business directory built to help people discover trusted businesses, professionals and services across Kerala.

KDIAL is a Kerala-first business discovery platform connecting customers with businesses through structured listings, search, WhatsApp enquiries, maps and business profiles.

Website: https://kdial.in

## Core Features

- [Business Listings](https://kdial.in/): Verified premium business profiles across Kerala.
- [Local Search](https://kdial.in/): City + category discovery for Kerala businesses.
- [Business Categories](https://kdial.in/): 100+ industries covered.
- [Premium Listings](https://kdial.in/#pricing): Paid-only directory — founder offer ₹501/year.
- [WhatsApp Contact](https://wa.me/917356137106): Customers reach businesses directly via WhatsApp.
- [Blog](https://kdial.in/blog): Guides for Kerala businesses on visibility and lead generation.

## Coverage

All 14 districts of Kerala — Thiruvananthapuram, Kollam, Pathanamthitta, Alappuzha, Kottayam, Idukki, Ernakulam, Thrissur, Palakkad, Malappuram, Kozhikode, Wayanad, Kannur, Kasaragod.

## Industries

Restaurants, Hotels, Hospitals, Clinics, Doctors, Schools, Colleges, Retail Stores, Home Services, Real Estate, Automotive, Travel, Finance, Education, Beauty, Wellness, Legal Services, IT Companies, Marketing Agencies and other local businesses.

## Business Model

Premium-only, verified business listings for businesses operating in Kerala. No free listings, no lead reselling.

## Audience

Consumers looking for trusted local businesses, and businesses seeking greater online visibility across Kerala.
